Module jakarta.data
Package jakarta.data.spi.expression.path

Interface NumericPath<T,U,N extends Number & Comparable<N>>

Type Parameters:
T - entity type
U - type of the intermediate embeddable or association that owns the navigated attribute
N - numeric type of the navigated attribute
All Superinterfaces:
ComparableExpression<T,N>, Expression<T,N>, NumericExpression<T,N>, Path<T,U>
public interface NumericPath<T,U,N extends Number & Comparable<N>> extends Path<T,U>, NumericExpression<T,N>
A path that navigates to a NumericAttribute. The path is represented as a NumericExpression.

  • Method Details

    • of

      @Nonnull static <T, U, N extends Number & Comparable<N>> NumericPath<T,U,N> of(@Nonnull NavigableExpression<T,U> expression, @Nonnull NumericAttribute<U,N> attribute)
      Obtains a NumericPath representing navigation from the given expression to the given NumericAttribute.

      This class is part of the Jakarta Data SPI for Jakarta Data providers. Applications must not use the SPI directly and can instead invoke NavigableExpression.navigate(NumericAttribute) starting from a navigable metamodel attribute to access a numeric path expression.

      Type Parameters:
      T - entity type
      U - type of the intermediate object that owns the navigated attribute
      N - numeric type of the navigated attribute
      Parameters:
      expression - the expression from which to navigate
      attribute - the numeric attribute to which to navigate
      Returns:
      a NumericPath representing the path
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either argument is null
